mission.objective: Add a deterministic test to test/mission-runtime.test.mjs proving that one valid actor action resets consecutiveRefusals: inject a refusal, then a valid read action, then another refusal, then a valid edit that passes verification. With maxConsecutiveRefusals set to 2, assert the actor remains eligible after the separated refusals and ultimately produces a verified candidate.
constraints: Do not weaken or remove existing assertions.
The test itself must make no provider calls.
Use a deterministic injected dispatch sequence and assert the verified outcome and exact wave count.
